sn31.2:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn31.2:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 5
sn31.2:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritam carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati ||
sn31.2:1.6: Gandhabbakāyikā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 6
sn31.2:1.8: Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti || ||
sn31.2:1.9: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjati || || 7
sn31.2:1.10: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā gandhabbakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti || || 1-4
